page.layout: One printed page with running text in one main column; a narrow marginal column of notes on the right edge, partly cut off by the scan edge; a second printed page partly visible at the far right edge with fragments of text.
page.running_head: C.10. De Genere tropi in verb. Inst.

main_text.l: quod eâdem Notione vel Logicâ vel
Sed decent prius necesse est, esse de re ipsâ,
ita enim quia veritas non nisi una
est, non nisi una sententia vera esse potest;
rei impositæ, non sunt illico argumentum
falsitatis. Quod si ergo dissensionem nobis
Rhetoricam, ut aliis atque aliis vocibus & notion-
primò quòd Rhetores non eodem modo
alicujus alii, quos ad aliud genus
tropi ducant alii. Hinc enim necessario
alii. Superius cap. 6. monuimus: Chemnitium necedochen
pocula quando sævæ infecere novercæ. Et ita
Quintilianus elocutionis Rhet. lib. 1. pag. 18. §. de synecdoche.

page.notes: Right margin notes are cut off by the scan edge and are only partly legible; the fragments at the far right (syn, tot, tin, mo, do, Eft, etc.) belong to the adjoining page and are not transcribed. Marginal note at the left line 5 is a section mark. Several words in the text are damaged by show-through and blots; readings in the first and last paragraphs are uncertain.
